description: Suno Studio effect. Bitcrush-style amplitude staircase, drive, and filtered corruption for digital lo-fi and glitch textures. Apply to rendered audio inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Bitcrush-style amplitude staircase, drive, and filtered corruption for digital lo-fi and glitch textures.

drive.description: Pre-crush distortion drive into the tanh stage.
drive.label: Drive

crush.description: Effective bit depth for the amplitude staircase; lower is more crushed.
crush.label: Crush

tone.description: Lowpass corner over the crushed signal to tame or brighten the corruption.
tone.label: Tone

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
